title: Partner Rental Program Schedule: Program Share on Long Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rentals
content:
**Program share.** The partner program share of a Cardinal Rental Reimbursement invoice rate depends on two things: the repair shop, and the length of the rental. The repair shop is the one that wrote the latest estimate on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim. The length is the rental's covered days.

| Latest estimate on the claim written by | Covered days of the rental | Share of the rate |
|---|---|---|
| A Cardinal Select Shop | 14 or more | 0.90 (90%) |
| A shop outside the Select network | 14 or more | 0.97 (97%) |
| Either kind of shop | Fewer than 14 | Full rate |
| No shop kind recorded on an estimate | Any | Full rate |

The program share is applied once, to the lower of the rate recorded on the authorization and the option's daily limit. The shared day rate is rounded to the cent.

## Worked rates (hypothetical, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500, recorded rate $46.20, daily limit $50.00)

The lower of the recorded rate and the daily limit is $46.20.

| Shop | Covered days | Shared day rate |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Select Shop | 14 | $46.20 multiplied by 0.90, which is $41.58 |
| Shop outside the Select network | 20 | $46.20 multiplied by 0.97, which is $44.814, rounded to $44.81 |
| Cardinal Select Shop | 13 | $46.20 (full rate) |

## Boundary

At 13 covered days the full rate applies. At 14 covered days the share applies.
